description:
The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is a prestigious award scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

It was launched in 2013 by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The primary aim of the Khel Pratibha Puraskar is to recognize and promote young sports talent in the country. 

The scheme is designed to encourage and motivate young athletes to pursue sports at a competitive level. 

The awards are given to outstanding sports persons who have shown exceptional talent in various sports disciplines. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is targeted at athletes in the age group of 14 to 20 years. 

The scheme aims to identify and nurture talent at an early stage. 

It seeks to provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their skills and potential. 

The awards are intended to inspire youth participation in sports across India. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar includes a cash prize and a certificate of recognition. 

The cash prize for each awardee is ₹5 lakh. 

The awards are given annually based on the performance of athletes in national and international competitions. 

The selection process for the awards is conducted by a committee formed by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

This committee evaluates the performance of athletes based on specific criteria. 

The criteria include performance in national championships, international competitions, and overall contribution to sports. 

The awards are presented during the National Sports Day celebrations on August 29 each year. 

This date commemorates the birth anniversary of the legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar aims to promote a sports culture in schools and colleges. 

It encourages educational institutions to support and nurture young talent. 

The scheme also aims to bridge the gap between sports and education. 

The eligibility criteria for the Khel Pratibha Puraskar include being an Indian citizen. 

Applicants must be aged between 14 and 20 years as of December 31 of the award year. 

Athletes must have participated in recognized national or international competitions. 

They should have achieved significant performance benchmarks in their respective sports. 

The application process for the Khel Pratibha Puraskar involves several steps. 

Interested athletes must submit their applications through the official website of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

The application form requires details such as personal information, sports achievements, and endorsements from coaches or sports associations. 

Applicants must provide documentary evidence of their sports achievements. 

This includes certificates from recognized sports bodies and proof of participation in competitions. 

The deadline for submitting applications is usually set for June 30 each year. 

After the submission deadline, the evaluation process begins. 

The selection committee reviews all applications and shortlists candidates based on merit. 

The final list of awardees is announced in July. 

Awardees are invited to the National Sports Day ceremony for the formal presentation of the awards. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is part of a broader initiative to enhance sports infrastructure in India. 

The government aims to create a conducive environment for sports development. 

This includes investments in training facilities and coaching programs. 

The scheme also aligns with the government's vision of promoting sports as a means of holistic development. 

The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports collaborates with various state governments and sports federations. 

This collaboration ensures that the benefits of the scheme reach deserving athletes across the country. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar has gained recognition and respect in the sports community. 

It serves as a motivational tool for young athletes to excel in their chosen sports. 

The awards have also helped in identifying potential Olympians and national-level players. 

The government has emphasized the importance of sports in youth development. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is a testament to this commitment. 

The scheme has seen participation from a diverse range of sports disciplines. 

These include athletics, swimming, badminton, wrestling, and many others. 

The awards not only provide financial support but also enhance the visibility of young athletes. 

This visibility can lead to further opportunities for sponsorship and support. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is an essential part of India's sports policy framework. 

It reflects the government's dedication to fostering a sports culture in the country. 

The scheme is continuously evolving to adapt to the changing landscape of sports in India. 

It aims to ensure that young athletes receive the recognition they deserve. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is a significant step towards building a robust sports ecosystem. 

It encourages young talent to dream big and strive for excellence in sports. 

The initiative has the potential to transform the future of sports in India. 

By investing in youth talent, the government aims to create a legacy of sporting excellence. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is not just an award but a commitment to the future of Indian sports. 

It symbolizes the belief that with the right support and recognition, young athletes can achieve greatness. 

The scheme continues to inspire countless young sports enthusiasts across the nation. 

It stands as a beacon of hope for aspiring athletes aiming for national and international glory. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is a vital component of India's journey towards becoming a sporting powerhouse. 

It highlights the importance of nurturing talent from a young age. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's proactive approach to sports development. 

It seeks to create champions who can represent India on global platforms. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is a celebration of talent dedication and hard work in sports. 

It reinforces the notion that sports can play a crucial role in national pride and identity. 

The scheme is a call to action for all stakeholders in the sports ecosystem. 

It encourages collaboration between government bodies educational institutions and sports organizations. 

The Khel Pratibha Puraskar is paving the way for a brighter future for Indian sports.
